versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

Coming from an old nightly? It is now a separate app (ARMSX2 Nightly) that installs
beside the stable app. The old nightly cannot install a stable over itself, because
Android refuses that version downgrade, so to return to stable: back up your saves
and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install a stable APK.

## What's new
- GS/Vulkan: copy overlapping draw and sample areas into the clone once
- GS/Vulkan: order the expansion index buffer's upload before its first draw
- GS: clone the target for an offset read whose filter reaches its own writes
- Android: name memory card backups .zip instead of .mcbak
- Android: decide the data folder once, and never fall back to internal storage silently
- GS/OpenGL: only reach for the headless EGL context where GLContextEGL is built
- GS/HW: draw AA1 lines above native with the vertex-shader expansion
- GS/OpenGL: let the dump runner open a GL context with no window
- GS/Vulkan: resolve the feedback carry where its inputs are final
- GS/Vulkan: feature-detection comments state what holds, not how it was found
- GS: tests for the Adreno and Mali GPU profiles
- GS/OpenGL: one Adreno depth-feedback block, not two
- GS: give the Mali r44p1 workaround one home
- GS/Vulkan: vendor and device-name rules live in the GPU profile
- GS/Vulkan: split CheckFeatures into the decisions it makes
- GS: the renderer decides each draw's feedback-loop state; Vulkan applies it
- GS: one header for the per-draw self-read rules

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260924...59e2b17ed0aa2b44ec0aaa2b48037437b1f12d62
